content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The landscape for selling digital music has evolved, yet many creators still rely on outdated platforms that impose high fees and restrictive terms. With services like Gumroad charging up to 10% on sales, the need for a more efficient system is clear. By using NOWPayments, which only charges a mere 0.5%, creators can retain significantly more revenue. For example, with 100 sales of a $97 music track, the difference amounts to $921 retained in your pocket. This direct comparison highlights the importance of choosing the right infrastructure for your digital commerce needs.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Selling music online requires a robust architecture that manages transactions, product delivery, and customer data with efficiency and security. At the core, a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, alongside Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, provides a solid foundation. These tools allow for seamless integration with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. The automated delivery of your music files can be handled through platforms like Google Drive, ensuring that once a purchase is made, the buyer immediately receives their product. This architecture not only ensures smooth operations but also enhances the creator's control over their digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors have failed. If you are a musician in Nigeria, Kenya, or similar areas, you likely encounter barriers when trying to sell your music online. By utilizing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you are not just finding a workaround; you are establishing a powerful platform that puts you in full control of your business. This architecture is designed for those who demand sovereignty over their sales processes and want to take advantage of the growing crypto economy.
NOWPayments saves you 9.5% compared to traditional platforms on every sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To set up your system for selling music online, you need to deploy several key components. Start with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to showcase your music. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle your backend logic, enabling secure and efficient payment processing via NOWPayments. For product storage and delivery, use Google Drive to host your music files and ensure instant download access for your customers. Collectively, these tools create a cohesive system that allows you to sell your music without relying on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with selling your music online, first, choose your hosting platform—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. Upload your music files to Google Drive and configure the automatic delivery system. Finally, test the entire process to ensure a smooth customer experience. By following these steps, you can quickly establish a reliable digital storefront tailored to your needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign commerce stack. This architecture allows you to host your products and manage transactions independently. Tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing enable you to retain full control over your sales without incurring high platform fees.
Own your sales process without relying on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell my music online without using PayPal?

You can sell your music online by using a sovereign commerce stack that includes hosting, backend logic, and cryptocurrency payment processing. This method bypasses the need for PayPal or other conventional platforms.
What are the fees associated with selling music online?

Using NOWPayments incurs a fee of only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This difference can lead to substantial savings as your sales volume increases.
How do I deliver my music files after purchase?

You can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your music files and set up automated delivery. This ensures that customers receive their purchased files immediately after completing the transaction.
Is it possible to sell music and accept Bitcoin?
Yes, by integrating NOWPayments with your digital storefront, you can accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, providing an efficient payment solution for your music sales.
What tools do I need to start selling music online?
To start selling your music online, you need a hosting solution, backend processing tools, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. This combination creates a fully functional digital storefront.
